notes: Pin status: 'ok' = HIGH/MEDIUM resolve-pin.py point or wikipedia point of the named feature; 'provisional' = town/park centroid, area hint or a feature of a different shape; the pins stage re-runs resolve-pin.py. Candidate coordinates that were clearly wrong (Whisky Bay in Antarctica, Bastion Point in Auckland, Squeaky Beach at the park centroid, Tongue Point in Washington, etc.) were replaced by resolve-pin.py points.
Renamed 'Tooronga Falls' to Toorongo Falls. Agnes Falls re-pinned from OSM waterfall near Toora (Agnes Falls Scenic Reserve). Mount Bishop pin is OSM 'Bishop Peak'; confirm.
Stick Shed note (recheck): Murtoa's Stick Shed is in the Wimmera, not Gippsland, so it is not placed here.

Wilsons Promontory National Park, Croajingolong National Park, Gippsland Lakes are the destinations themselves; the candidates of those names are not spots of themselves. Candidates 'Gippsland Lakes' and the park candidates map to their new destinations.

Walhalla is not a destination: with Baw Baw National Park, Mount Baw Baw and Toorongo Falls there are only 3 spots under a Baw Baw destination. Sale is a hub with two attractions (standalone). Flagged for owner.
Standalone Sale is a wrapper beside Sale Swing Bridge and Gippsland Art Gallery; kept because the skeptic kept it, but the owner may drop it.
